messages.author: 9c36e191a2423678
messages.subject: RRO 8.0.1 and jags
parts: Had to uninstall RRO again. This time running 8.0.1 on OSX 10.10.2 (Yosemite). Tried using some example code running jags from Kruschke's 'Doing Bayesian Data Analysis' and it fails. There seems to be an issue with RRO and X11. Going back to CRAN R completely solves the problem.

messages.author: 0eb5a09fd4de9e5e
messages.subject: Re: RRO 8.0.1 and jags
parts:
Hi, David

Thank you for reporting this problem.  Do you know which version of RRO-8.0.1 you had installed?  We withdrew an earlier version and released an update RRO-8.0.1-beta2 to fix some known issues on OSX.  (See http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/download/#download)

I'll ask somebody in the team to try this on the latest version for Mac.

Regards

Andrie

messages.author: fd293f6d1c0941b5
messages.subject: Re: RRO 8.0.1 and jags
parts:
Hi Andrie,

I have started using the beta 2 version for the last 2 weeks on my iMac. I have scripts with 1300 lines. Every time I try to open my third script, it opens the choose file window but it got stuck on that screen and about 3 or 4 minutes later RRO crashes with a classical rotating rainbow mouse pointer. It can't even reach the folder that contains my scripts where I also set as my directory. It just got stuck with Documents folder selected and don't even show any folders.

I uninstalled it twice and this is the third time I am using it and this still happens. As a side note, mlogit and systemfit packages are loaded at the background. Don't expect it to be related but just wanted to let you know.

Let me know if there is a known issue and will just uninstall it and keep using the original R platform.

Thanks,

Necati
